intro.h2: Work done like it is our own home
paragraphs: Revered Renovations & Remodeling LLC handles kitchen remodeling and home repairs, plus snow removal when winter arrives. Josh is the name in our reviews, and one customer says his attention to detail surpasses any other contractor he has worked with, because Josh works in your home the way he would work in his own.

That same care shows up in the small jobs. Faucet repair, quality workmanship and fair pricing are the topics customers bring up most often. Two households have trusted us with their snow plowing for years, and we keep our blade raised on spacers so a rock driveway stays where it belongs.

items.name: Kitchen updates
items.blurb: A kitchen can change a lot without moving a wall. In the kitchen shown, the cabinets are painted a soft blue, a stacked stone backsplash runs behind the counters and range, and white countertops brighten the whole room under new light fixtures.

image.alt: Kitchen with soft blue painted cabinets, stacked stone backsplash, white counters and geometric ceiling lights

items.name: Kitchenettes and coffee bars
items.blurb: Spare corners make great kitchenettes. This one pairs a butcher block counter and sink with gray cabinets, a floating coffee bar with stools, a wood-look tile inset set into the carpet and a sliding barn door on black hardware.

image.alt: Kitchenette with a butcher block counter, gray cabinets, a floating coffee bar with two stools and a sliding barn door

items.name: Faucet and fixture repair
items.blurb: A dripping faucet is small until it is not. Faucet repair is one of the jobs customers mention in our reviews. We fix leaks and worn parts, and tell you plainly when a repair makes sense and when a replacement would serve you better.

image.ai_prompt: Photorealistic photo of a newly installed matte black single-handle kitchen faucet over a black undermount sink set in a white countertop, a stacked stone backsplash behind it and soft blue painted cabinets below, warm morning light from a window, clean and finished, no people, no faces, no text, no logos, no brand names, 4:3
image.alt: Matte black kitchen faucet over a black sink with a stacked stone backsplash

items.name: Snow removal
items.blurb: When winter hits we plow driveways and clear deck areas too. Customers have kept us for years for being reliable and thorough. On gravel and rock driveways we raise the plow edge with two-inch spacers so the rock stays put.

image.ai_prompt: Photorealistic photo of a freshly plowed gravel driveway with neat snowbanks on both sides leading to a wood-sided house with a cleared deck, evergreen trees dusted with snow, crisp blue winter sky, soft morning light, no people, no faces, no text, no logos, no brand names, 4:3
image.alt: Freshly plowed gravel driveway between snowbanks leading to a house with a cleared deck

why_choose_us.h2: Why customers stick with Revered Renovations

items.title: Detail you notice
items.text: Quality workmanship is the most common topic in our reviews. One customer says Josh's attention to detail surpasses every other contractor he has worked with.

items.title: Fair pricing
items.text: Fair pricing comes up again and again in what customers write about us. We price the job honestly and talk it through before the work starts.

items.title: Year after year
items.text: One household has had us plow their snow for the past three years and calls us reliable, responsible and dependable. Another has kept us for a couple of winters.

items.title: Feedback after the job
items.text: Customers say Josh is responsive and available when needed. After a job he tells you what was done, so you are never left guessing about the work.

about.text: Revered Renovations & Remodeling LLC is a small contractor run with a simple idea: treat every project as if it were for our own family. Josh is the person customers deal with, whether the job is a kitchen update, a leaky faucet or a driveway buried in snow. Reviewers describe him as responsive, available and careful with the details that other contractors skip. We work Tuesday through Saturday from 7 AM to 7 PM, and we are glad to talk through your plans.

service_area.text: Our Google profile does not list an address or service area yet, so we would rather ask than guess. Call (660) 262-8765 Tuesday through Saturday between 7 AM and 7 PM, tell us where you live and what you need, whether that is a kitchen update, a repair or a spot on our winter plowing route, and we will tell you right away whether we can help.

items.q: What kind of work do you do?
items.a: We remodel and update kitchens, build kitchenettes and coffee bars, and handle repairs such as faucets. In winter we also plow snow and clear deck areas. Our reviews mention quality workmanship and fair pricing most often. If your project is not listed here, call and ask.

items.q: Do you take on small repairs?
items.a: Yes. Faucet repair is one of the jobs customers mention in our reviews, and small jobs get the same care as remodels. Josh works in your home the way he would work in his own, so even a quick fix is done neatly and explained when it is finished.

items.q: Will your plow damage my gravel or rock driveway?
items.a: We take care to avoid it. On rock driveways we keep the plow edge raised with two-inch spacers, so the rock stays on the driveway instead of ending up in the street. Customers also mention that we clear deck areas thoroughly, not just the drive.

We are open Tuesday through Saturday from 7 AM to 7 PM and closed on Sunday and Monday, so plan your call for later in the week. Call (660) 262-8765 during those hours, or email reveredrr@gmail.com with a few photos and a short description of what you need.

items.q: How do I get a price?
items.a: Call or email us with the details. We talk through the project with you, look at the space and give you a fair price before work begins. Fair pricing is one of the things customers mention most often when they review us, alongside the quality of the finished work.

final_cta.h2: Have a project or a repair in mind?
final_cta.text: Call Josh to talk it through, Tuesday through Saturday.
